provenance_note: Hand-derived from 131.0-B-6 9.1.2, 9.2.1, 9.3.1 Figure 9-1, 11.3 and 732.0-B-5 2.4.1. Model test-vectors/models/sync.py, written blind (TV-023) by a Claude agent from the Blue Books and docs/ only, without reading any implementation; for format only it read the existing models (cop1.py, link_recv.py) and the vector schemas. The inputs were chosen by hand; the expected values are the model's, whose sequences it checks against the 40-bit notes of 131.0-B-6 10.4.3 (note 2) and whose search engine it checks against a second, offline formulation. Where the documents are silent the model refuses the case (README of test-vectors/sync/). The file is written by the model (--write) and never edited by hand.

A frame that holds the marker twice is attached as given: the CADU is the marker, then those octets (131.0 9.2.1).
An all-zero frame is not changed by the attach (the randomizer is a separate step, 10.3.4 note 1).
An all-ones frame is not changed by the attach.
